summary.text: Amy Roeder is a Democratic state representative from Maine House District 23 who is running for Maine State Senate District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election; she is not seeking re-election to the House.
A former professional actor and arts nonprofit executive director, she advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Amy Roeder was born in Minneapolis, Minnesota, and graduated from New London-Spicer High School.

She earned a bachelor's degree in theatre from the University of Evansville in 1995, a master's degree in theatre from the University of Georgia in 2009, and a graduate degree from the University of Maine in 2022.

Her career experience includes working as an adjunct professor with the University of Maine, executive director of an arts nonprofit organization, education director of a local professional theatre, a freelance business trainer, and a professional actor.
She has been affiliated with the Actors' Equity Association, the Screen Actors Guild-American Federation of Television and Radio Artists, and the Part-Time Faculty Association.
